title: Meta's Giant Open AI Runs on Just Two Macs
description:
Meta just released Muse Spark Open, an open-weight AI model built with help from Apple, and it's tuned to run on just two Mac Studios.
We bust two myths: giant AI needs a data center, and open models are small toys. It has 816 billion parameters (about 42 billion active per token) and a 1-million-token context, but its license limits some commercial use.
